query: select p.id as product_id,p.title,p.slug,p.status as product_status,p.dimensions as product_dimensions,p.fulfillment_type,p.master_artwork_id,v.id as variant_id,v.name as variant_name,v.variant_type,v.medium,v.size_label,v.width_in,v.height_in,v.size_tier,v.is_custom_size,v.aspect_ratio as stored_aspect_ratio,v.is_active,v.studio_is_active,v.studio_only,v.updated_at as variant_updated_at,v.fulfillment_metadata->>'size' as fulfillment_size,m.width_px as raw_width_px,m.height_px as raw_height_px,m.print_width_px,m.print_height_px,m.crop_box,m.border_mode,m.print_status,m.print_updated_at,m.file_size_bytes from public.products p full outer join public.product_variants v on v.product_id=p.id left join public.master_artworks m on m.id=p.master_artwork_id order by p.title nulls last,v.medium nulls last,v.width_in nulls last,v.height_in nulls last,v.id;
